faculty.name: Mariam Aly
faculty.summary: Studies how perception and memory interact, using behavioral studies, fMRI, and patient studies to understand memory systems and their influence on attention and perception.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究感知与记忆之间的相互作用，通过行为研究、fMRI 和患者研究来理解记忆系统及其对注意力和感知的影响。

faculty.name: Ozlem Ayduk
faculty.summary: Studies how self-distancing and emotion regulation develop in children and close relationships.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自我疏离和情绪调节在儿童和亲密关系中的发展。

faculty.name: Jasmin Brooks Stephens
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of sociocultural factors on mental health, particularly among Black youth and emerging adults, focusing on suicide prevention and racial trauma.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会文化因素对黑人青少年和新兴成年人心理健康的影响，特别是自杀预防和种族创伤。

faculty.name: Silvia Bunge
faculty.summary: Studies the development and plasticity of higher cognitive functions in humans, focusing on reasoning, learning, and goal-directed behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类高级认知功能的发展和可塑性，重点在于推理、学习和目标导向行为。

faculty.name: Serena Chen
faculty.summary: Studies self and identity, self-compassion, and close relationships, exploring how social power affects interpersonal dynamics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自我和身份、自我同情以及亲密关系，探讨社会权力如何影响人际动态。

faculty.name: Anne Collins
faculty.summary: Studies how learning, decision-making, and executive functions are processed by cognitive and neural systems using computational modeling and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习、决策和执行功能的认知和神经处理过程，使用计算建模和行为实验。

faculty.name: Mark D'Esposito
faculty.summary: Studies the neural bases of working memory and executive control using fMRI, pharmacological studies, and behavioral experiments in patient populations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究工作记忆和执行控制的神经基础，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、药理学研究和患者行为实验。

faculty.name: Gul Dolen
faculty.summary: Studies how psychedelics can reopen critical periods for therapeutic benefits, focusing on social behaviors and the extracellular matrix.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究致幻剂如何重新打开关键期以实现治疗效益，重点关注社会行为和细胞外基质。

faculty.name: Marina Dubova
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive mechanisms of discovery, concept learning, and theory building, including social learning and experimentation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知发现机制、概念学习和理论构建，包括社会学习和实验研究。

faculty.name: Arianne Eason
faculty.summary: Studies how social and cultural contexts shape attitudes and behaviors towards diverse groups, focusing on racial segregation, media representation, and resource allocations in infancy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会和文化背景如何塑造人们对不同群体的态度和行为，重点关注种族隔离、媒体代表性以及婴儿期资源分配。

faculty.name: Jan Engelmann
faculty.summary: Studies how children and chimpanzees develop and differ in cooperative skills and motivations, focusing on prosociality and fairness.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童和黑猩猩在合作技能和动机方面的差异和发展，重点在于亲社会行为和公平感。

faculty.name: Aaron Fisher
faculty.summary: Studies psychopathology at the individual and momentary level, using configural psychometrics to identify necessary and sufficient clinical configurations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究个体和瞬时的心理障碍，使用构型心理测量学来识别必要的和充分的临床配置。

faculty.name: Manuel Galvan
faculty.summary: Studies how unequal social contexts shape psychology and behavior, exacerbating economic and racial disparities, using distributional approaches and interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究不平等的社会环境如何塑造心理和行为，加剧经济和种族不平等，采用分布性方法和干预措施。

faculty.name: Allison Harvey
faculty.summary: Develops treatments for mental illness, focusing on behavior change and transdiagnostic processes, particularly sleep disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发治疗精神疾病的方法，重点关注行为改变和跨诊断过程，特别是睡眠障碍。

faculty.name: Stephen Hinshaw
faculty.summary: Studies the development and long-term outcomes of ADHD in girls and women, focusing on stigma, self-harm, and neurocognitive vulnerabilities.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究女孩和女性注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）的发展和长期结果，重点关注污名、自伤和神经认知脆弱性。

faculty.name: Richard Ivry
faculty.summary: Studies how people select, plan, and produce movement, using behavioral studies, TMS, fMRI, and computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何选择、计划和产生运动，使用行为研究、TMS、fMRI 和计算建模方法。

faculty.name: Oliver P. John
faculty.summary: Studies self-concept and self-perception accuracy, examining how individuals understand themselves and others across the lifespan.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自我概念和自我感知准确性，探讨个体如何在一生中理解自己和他人。

faculty.name: Sheri Johnson
faculty.summary: Studies the mechanisms and outcomes of emotion-related impulsivity in bipolar disorder, using fMRI, behavioral, and self-report measures.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究双相障碍中情绪相关冲动的机制和结果，使用功能性磁共振成像、行为和自我报告测量方法。

faculty.name: Keanan Joyner
faculty.summary: Studies the etiology of addiction and the representation of Black individuals in psychophysiological research, using EEG/ERPs and EMA.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成瘾的起因以及黑人在生理心理研究中的代表性问题，使用EEG/ERPs和EMA方法。

faculty.name: Dacher Keltner
faculty.summary: Studies the social functions of emotion, including the roles of embarrassment, love, and awe in social interactions, and how individual differences in positive emotions affect relationships and.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪的社会功能，包括尴尬、爱和敬畏在社会互动中的作用，以及积极情绪差异如何影响人际关系和幸福感。

faculty.name: Celeste Kidd
faculty.summary: Studies how children learn and explore using computational models and behavioral experiments, focusing on attention and curiosity in infancy and childhood.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童学习和探索的过程，使用计算模型和行为实验，重点关注婴儿期和儿童期的注意力和好奇心。

faculty.name: Hedy Kober
faculty.summary: Studies the neural and psychological mechanisms of craving regulation in substance use and eating disorders, using mindfulness and cognitive strategies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成瘾和进食障碍中渴望调节的神经和心理机制，使用正念和认知策略。

faculty.name: Lance Kriegsfeld
faculty.summary: Studies the genetic, cellular, and hormonal mechanisms of circadian rhythms and their impact on motivated behaviors and physiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究昼夜节律的遗传、细胞和激素机制及其对动机行为和生理功能的影响。

faculty.name: Iris Mauss
faculty.summary: Studies emotions and emotion regulation, linking them to health using various measures and approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪及其调节与健康的关系，使用多种测量和方法。

faculty.name: R. Mendoza-Denton
faculty.summary: Studies how social and cultural factors influence intergroup relations, stigma, and prejudice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会和文化因素如何影响群体关系、污名和偏见。

faculty.name: Daniel DongWon Oh
faculty.summary: Studies social cognition and perception, focusing on individual differences, stereotypes, and cultural influences.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会认知和知觉，关注个体差异、刻板印象和文化影响。

faculty.name: Steven Piantadosi
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive development, focusing on how children learn and process information.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知发展，关注儿童如何学习和处理信息。

faculty.name: Giovanni Ramos
faculty.summary: Studies risk and resilience factors for Latinx mental health, adapting evidence-based treatments, and developing digital interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究拉丁裔人群的心理健康风险和韧性因素，改进基于证据的治疗方法，并开发数字干预措施。

faculty.name: Amitai Shenhav
faculty.summary: Studies the neural and computational mechanisms of motivation, affect, decision-making, and cognitive control using cognitive neuroscience methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动机、情感、决策和认知控制的神经和计算机制，采用认知神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Mahesh Srinivasan
faculty.summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

faculty.name: William Thompson
faculty.summary: Studies the social foundations of human intelligence, including language and creative thinking, using behavioral experiments and computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类智能的社会基础，包括语言和创造性思维，使用行为实验和计算建模方法。

faculty.name: Kevin Weiner
faculty.summary: Studies the structural-functional relationships in the brain, particularly in the fusiform gyrus, using various imaging techniques in both living and post-mortem individuals.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑结构与功能的关系，特别是在 Fusiform 窦，使用多种成像技术在活体和死后个体中进行分析。

faculty.name: David Whitney
faculty.summary: Studies visual perception and attention, focusing on how these processes guide actions, using cognitive neuroscience methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和注意力，关注这些过程如何指导行动，使用认知神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Linda Wilbrecht
faculty.summary: Studies how experience shapes brain circuits involved in decision making and addiction, using behavioral and systems neuroscience approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究经验如何塑造与决策和成瘾相关的脑回路，采用行为和系统神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Fei Xu
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive and language development in infants, focusing on word learning and social cognition.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿的认知和语言发展，重点关注词汇学习和社会认知。

faculty.name: Qing Zhou
faculty.summary: Studies the development of behavioral problems and competence in children and adolescents, focusing on temperament, emotion regulation, parenting, and cultural context.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童和青少年行为问题和能力的发展，重点关注气质、情绪调节、养育方式和文化背景。

faculty.name: Hillel Adesnik
faculty.summary: Studies the plasticity, connectivity, and dynamics of neural networks.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经网络的可塑性、连接性和动态变化。

faculty.name: Gopala Anumanchipalli
faculty.summary: Develops speech technologies to assist people with disordered speech, using automated methods for diagnosis and rehabilitation.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发语音技术以辅助言语障碍患者，使用自动化方法进行诊断和康复。

faculty.name: Helen Bateup
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular basis of synapse and circuit changes in epilepsy and autism.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究癫痫和自闭症中突触和神经回路变化的分子基础。

faculty.name: Annaliese Beery
faculty.summary: Studies the mechanisms supporting social bonding between peers and the neuroendocrinology of complex behaviors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究同伴之间社会纽带的机制及其复杂行为的神经内分泌学。

faculty.name: Yang Dan
faculty.summary: Studies neural circuits controlling sleep and mechanisms of executive control, using circuit-level approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究控制睡眠的神经回路和执行控制的机制，采用电路级的方法。

faculty.name: Michael DeWeese
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of auditory processing and selective attention in the cerebral cortex and artificial neural networks.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑皮层中的听觉处理和选择性注意的神经机制以及人工神经网络。

faculty.name: Gül Dölen
faculty.summary: Studies social behaviors, psychedelics, and synaptic plasticity in octopuses and humans, exploring critical periods and oxytocin effects.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会行为、致幻剂和突触可塑性，涉及八爪鱼和人类，探索关键时期和催产素的作用。

faculty.name: David Feinberg
faculty.summary: Develops MRI technology to map visual circuitry and neurovascular coupling.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发MRI技术以映射视觉电路和神经血管耦合。

faculty.name: Daniel Feldman
faculty.summary: Studies how sensory processing and plasticity occur in the somatosensory cortex.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究感觉处理和皮层可塑性在体感皮层中的发生机制。

faculty.name: Marla Feller
faculty.summary: Studies the functional development and organization of neural circuits in the retina.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视网膜神经回路的功能发育和组织.

faculty.name: Yvette Fisher
faculty.summary: Studies how neural circuits adapt during spatial navigation, using flexible cognitive strategies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究空间导航过程中神经电路的适应性，使用灵活的认知策略。

faculty.name: David Foster
faculty.summary: Studies how neural ensembles in the hippocampus encode spatial memory and navigation toward rewards.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究海马神经群体如何编码空间记忆和导航至奖励的过程。

faculty.name: Meng-meng Fu
faculty.summary: Studies glial function in development and disease using animal, cell, and molecular approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究胶质细胞在发育和疾病中的功能，使用动物、细胞和分子方法。

faculty.name: Jack Gallant
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain represents information about the world and its own mental states using brain imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用脑成像技术研究大脑如何表示世界信息及其自身心理状态。

faculty.name: Liberty Hamilton
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of speech and language processing in the developing brain using statistical methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用统计方法研究发育中大脑的语音和语言处理的神经机制。

faculty.name: Ming Hsu
faculty.summary: Studies consumer behavior and decision-making using brain imaging techniques, integrating economics and marketing.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用脑成像技术研究消费者行为和决策，结合经济学和营销学。

faculty.name: Alexander Huth
faculty.summary: Studies how language and meaning are processed in the brain using computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言和意义在大脑中的处理过程，使用计算模型方法。

faculty.name: Ehud Isacoff
faculty.summary: Studies the function of ion channels, synapse development, plasticity, and neural circuit function.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究离子通道功能、突触发育、可塑性和神经环路功能。

faculty.name: William Jagust
faculty.summary: Studies the anatomic, biochemical, and neurochemical bases of brain aging and dementia.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑衰老和痴呆的解剖学、生物化学和神经化学基础。

faculty.name: Na Ji
faculty.summary: Develops novel imaging methods to understand brain function.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发新型成像方法以理解大脑功能。

faculty.name: YoungJu Jo
faculty.summary: Develops and applies neurotechnologies to measure and control neural dynamics in behaving animals, combining systems and computational neuroscience with optical and genetic engineering.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发和应用神经技术来测量和控制行为动物的神经动力学，结合系统和计算神经科学与光学和基因工程。

faculty.name: Daniela Kaufer
faculty.summary: Studies molecular mechanisms of brain plasticity in response to stress and neurological insults.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究应激和神经损伤对大脑可塑性分子机制的影响。

faculty.name: Preeya Khanna
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of dexterous motor skills and develops neurotechnology to restore and rehabilitate movement.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究灵巧运动技能的神经基础，并开发神经技术以恢复和康复运动功能。

faculty.name: Bob Knight
faculty.summary: Studies neural coding for goal-directed behavior and develops brain-machine interfaces for motor and language prostheses.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究目标导向行为的神经编码并开发用于运动和语言假体的脑机接口。

faculty.name: Richard Kramer
faculty.summary: Develops non-invasive chemical reagents for sensing and manipulating ion channels and synapses.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发非侵入性化学试剂以感知和操控离子通道和突触。

faculty.name: Stephan Lammel
faculty.summary: Studies midbrain dopamine circuits in reward-based behaviors and pathological changes in addiction, depression, and schizophrenia.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究中脑多巴胺电路在奖励行为中的作用及其在成瘾、抑郁和精神分裂症中的病理变化。

faculty.name: Markita Landry
faculty.summary: Explores how nanomaterials can be used to study brain chemistry at a microscopic level.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用纳米材料探究大脑化学反应的微观机制。

faculty.name: Lexin Li
faculty.summary: Analyzes brain connectivity and imaging data using statistical methods and regression techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用统计方法和回归技术分析脑连接性和成像数据。

faculty.name: Chunlei Liu
faculty.summary: Develops MRI technology to study neural circuits and modulation.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发MRI技术研究神经回路和调控。

faculty.name: Bruno Olshausen
faculty.summary: Develops computational models to understand sensory coding and visual perception.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发计算模型来理解感觉编码和视觉知觉。

faculty.name: Teresa Puthussery
faculty.summary: Studies how visual signals are processed in healthy and diseased retinas.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究健康和患病视网膜中视觉信号的处理机制。

faculty.name: Michael Silver
faculty.summary: Studies the neurophysiological and neurochemical bases of visual perception, attention, and learning using advanced neuroscience techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉感知、注意力和学习的神经生理和神经化学基础，采用先进的神经科学技术。

faculty.name: Sergey Stavisky
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiology of speech and language.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言和言语的神经生物学。

faculty.name: Mark Tanouye
faculty.summary: Studies the genetic causes of epilepsy and other nervous system disorders using novel genetic approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用新颖的遗传方法研究癫痫和其他神经系统疾病的遗传原因。

faculty.name: Rowland Taylor
faculty.summary: Studies the structure and function of neural circuits in the retina.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视网膜神经回路的结构和功能。

faculty.name: Frédéric Theunissen
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain processes complex sounds, using auditory perception experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究复杂声音的听觉处理机制，使用听觉感知实验方法。

faculty.name: Doris Tsao
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain constructs a model of the visual world.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何构建视觉世界的模型。

faculty.name: Joni Wallis
faculty.summary: Studies neuronal mechanisms underlying high-level cognitive and behavioral processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究高级认知和行为过程的神经机制。

faculty.name: Michael Ward
faculty.summary: Studies age-related neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's and Parkinson's, using molecular and cellular approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究与年龄相关的神经退行性疾病，包括阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病，采用分子和细胞方法。

faculty.name: Ke Xu
faculty.summary: Develops super-resolution fluorescence microscopy techniques to study cellular processes at the nanoscale.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发超分辨率荧光显微技术以研究细胞过程的纳米尺度.

faculty.name: Michael Yartsev
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of complex spatial and acoustic behaviors in animals.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究复杂空间和声学行为的神经基础。

faculty.name: Jacob Yates
faculty.summary: Studies how populations of neurons in cortex encode visual information, using statistical models and machine learning to understand neural activity and human perception.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究皮层神经元群体如何编码视觉信息，使用统计模型和机器学习来理解神经活动和人类知觉。
